verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs say components can be reused across files and that copies stay linked, so changes to the main component can reach them. That covers the core of cross-file reuse and update propagation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of shared-library publishing, sharing of styles (colors, typography) alongside components, cross-project scope, a controlled review/accept step for incoming updates, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes

citations.quote: A component is a layer or group of layers that can be reused multiple times across files.
All component copies used in a file are linked in a way that updates made to the Main component can reflect in their component copies.
